dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - Reliability - Anomaly and Baseline
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard comparing current throughput, latency, error rate, and log volume against recent baselines. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Baseline comparison
pages.description: Current behavior against recent baselines before static thresholds fire.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago COMPARE WITH 1 week ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 95), percentile(duration, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago COMPARE WITH 1 week ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago COMPARE WITH 1 week ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET level TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago COMPARE WITH 1 week ago

SELECT percentile(duration, 95), count(*), percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago COMPARE WITH 1 week ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET unit, level LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago COMPARE WITH 1 week ago

rawConfiguration.text: Use static thresholds for hard risk limits. Use anomaly conditions only after enough baseline data exists and noise is reviewed.
